name: faultlab
description: Deterministic distributed-systems simulation and debugging environment for the browser.
author: Joris van Rijn

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @faultlab/engine && npm run test --workspace @faultlab/trace && npm run test --workspace @faultlab/protocols && npm run test --workspace @faultlab/experiments && npm run test --workspace @faultlab/runtime && npm run test --workspace @faultlab/demo && npm run test --workspace @faultlab/web
scripts.test:explore: npm run test:explore --workspace @faultlab/engine && npm run test:explore --workspace @faultlab/protocols
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @faultlab/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @faultlab/trace && npm run typecheck --workspace @faultlab/protocols && npm run typecheck --workspace @faultlab/experiments && npm run typecheck --workspace @faultlab/runtime && npm run typecheck --workspace @faultlab/demo && npm run typecheck --workspace @faultlab/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e --workspace @faultlab/demo && npm run test:e2e --workspace @faultlab/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @faultlab/demo && npm run build --workspace @faultlab/web
scripts.perf: cd tools/perf && npx vite build --config vite.config.ts --ssr churn.ts && node .out/churn.mjs 160000
